title: Stellar AI - Production Monitoring
description: World-class monitoring dashboard for Stellar Global Supplies AI - Gemini Clone Backend

widgets.title: Apdex Score
widgets.nrql: SELECT Apdex(apm.service.transaction.duration, threshold: 0.5) FROM Metric WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 5 minutes ago

widgets.title: Error Rate
widgets.nrql: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error is true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: Throughput (Requests/min)
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET transactionName SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: Response Time by Endpoint
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(duration) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND transactionType = 'Web' FACET transactionName SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: HTTP Status Codes
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET http.statusCode SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Slowest Endpoints (Avg Duration)
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(duration) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND transactionType = 'Web' FACET transactionName SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Error Distribution by Type
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET error.class SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Top Error Messages
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) as 'Error Count', latest(error.message) as 'Latest Error', max(timestamp) as 'Last Occurred' FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 1 hour ago GROUP BY error.message ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Database Query Time
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(duration) FROM DatastoreStatement WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET statement SINCE 30 minutes ago LIMIT 5

widgets.title: Database Operations by Type
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM DatastoreStatement WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET datastoreOperation SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Slow Database Queries
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(duration) as 'Avg Duration', max(duration) as 'Max Duration', count(*) as 'Count' FROM DatastoreStatement WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 1 hour ago FACET statement ORDER BY average(duration) DESC LIMIT 10

widgets.title: External API Response Times
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(duration) FROM External WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET url SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: External API Error Rate
widgets.nrql: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE http.statusCode >= 400) FROM External WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET url SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: External API Call Volume
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM External WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET url SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: External API Status Codes
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM External WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET http.statusCode SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Authentication Success Rate
widgets.nrql: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error is false) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND transactionName LIKE '%/api/auth%' SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Rate Limiting Hits
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND http.statusCode = 429 SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Failed Authentication Attempts
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) as 'Failure Count', latest(error.message) as 'Error Message' FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND transactionName LIKE '%/api/auth%' SINCE 1 hour ago GROUP BY error.message ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10

pages.name: User Activity
pages.description: User engagement and feature usage metrics

widgets.title: Active Users (Unique Sessions)
widgets.nrql: SELECT uniqueCount(session) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Chat Messages per Minute
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND transactionName LIKE '%/api/chat%' SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: Search Queries per Minute
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND transactionName LIKE '%/api/search%' SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: Feature Usage Distribution (24h)
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET transactionName SINCE 24 hours ago

widgets.title: Memory Usage
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(memory.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024) as 'Heap Used (MB)', average(memory.heapTotal / 1024 / 1024) as 'Heap Total (MB)', average(memory.rss / 1024 / 1024) as 'RSS (MB)' FROM Metric WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: Event Loop Lag
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(eventLoopTime) FROM Metric WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: CPU Utilization
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(cpu.utilization) FROM Metric WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 30 minutes ago

widgets.title: Transaction Throughput
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 30 minutes ago
